One signature translation rescues the 3 single-cause files outright.

items.title: javac crash risk on BOTH driver classpaths: jsr305 missing from the tree and from both library paths (latent)
items.evidence: No tools/*.py file in the 1.21.11 tree mentions jsr305: test_model_baking_parity.py:client_libraries() builds the client classpath from the manifest only, test_rust_parity.py does NOT carry the 1.21.7 server-path fix (d7a14e91) that 1.21.10's tree has at lines 112-115, and oracle_harness.py / lab.py have no jsr305 handling. The jar itself is absent from the tree (versions/1.21.11/tools/jsr305-3.0.2.jar does not exist; the port workdir's copy, sha1 25ea2e8b, is what the measurement used) and no manifest library contains javax.annotation.Nullable (verified by listing all 99 library jars). Without jsr305, javac can crash (CompletionFailure: class file for javax.annotation.Nullable not found, rc=4) when compiling an oracle that completes a Nullable-referencing symbol — a latent crash across both the oracle_harness drivers and the direct server-path drivers. Worse than 1.21.10, where the jar existed in-tree and the server path was fixed.

items.title: Abstract-method gaps: Level.fuelValues() (5 oracles) + 1 other missing override
items.evidence: 1.21.11's Level declares public abstract FuelValues fuelValues() (javap-verified: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.FuelValues); the oracles' fake Level subclasses don't implement it: VanillaActiveEffectTickOracle, VanillaAttributeUpdatesOracle, VanillaBlockEntityAnimOracle, VanillaLivingLandingOracle (same 4 as 26.1.2 and 1.21.10), plus VanillaBlockEntityRenderOracle which references fuelValues() among its errors. One more missing-override file has a different abstract gap: VanillaDecorationRegionOracle (first error at line 49 — anonymous class missing a lookup… override on RegistryInfoLookup; 16 errors, same as 1.21.10). Mechanical repair: add a fuelValues() override returning a default to each fake level.

items.title: EntityTypes holder move: 30 oracles reference the 26.2+ holder absent from 1.21.11
items.evidence: 1.21.11 predates the EntityTypes/BlockEntityTypes move — registration still lives in net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType / net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType (the 1.21.x shape). items.title: 264 oracles fail javac on all three classpaths (67.5%); 289 drivers blocked
items.evidence: 127/391 oracles (32.5%) compile on at least one classpath; 264 fail on all three (server 102 pass / 289 fail, client 127 pass / 264 fail, both identical to client). items.title: MobAi driver gates nothing 1.21.11 cannot run: 16 age-lock scenarios ungated (spears + copper golem runnable here)
items.evidence: test_mob_ai_parity.py runs all 278 scenarios ungated (the 1.21.7 Batch 0 gating is NOT in the 1.21.11 tree). Against 1.21.11's own jar: copper golem EXISTS (11 jar entries — golem scenarios runnable) and spears EXIST (WOODEN_SPEAR…GOLDEN_SPEAR on Items, javap-verified — the 4 spear scenarios at lines 60-74 are runnable), so those parts of the 1.21.7/1.21.10 concern are withdrawn. But the AgeableMob age lock is ABSENT (no setAgeLocked/ageLocked — only setAge, javap-verified), so the 16 age scenarios ({pig,cow,horse,turtle}_age_{-2,2}_noai_{False,True}, lines 90-94) set an age the version cannot lock and will fail at runtime for want of the gating.

items.title: ComponentPatch oracle runtime crash: 26.x-only Removed class via reflection — FIXED in this tree
items.evidence: The 1.21.11 VanillaComponentPatchOracle uses the Optional.empty() form (the 1.21.7 repair form): patchText reads (java.util.Optional<?>)e.getValue() and text() handles null, with NO Class.forName("net.minecraft.core.component.Removed") anywhere in the file (verified by grep + diff vs the 1.21.10 oracle, which still carries the reflection at line 14). Removed has 0 entries in the 1.21.11 jars, but the oracle no longer references it, so the ClassNotFoundException cannot occur. The oracle compiles clean on all three classpaths. 1.21.10's O12 / 1.21.7's B0-O10 are FIXED for 1.21.11.

items.title: Template adaptations change oracle output formats; probe-side matching unverified
items.method: source read + re-check against the 1.21.11 measurement
items.evidence: Unlike 1.21.10 (whose O13 was closed because no format-changing repairs exist in that tree), the 1.21.11 tree DOES carry format-relevant oracle adaptations: VanillaSuffocationOracle outputs motion-based rule names ('motion_full' where the 26.x oracle outputs 'tagged_full' — '1.21.11 has no causes_suffocation tag: the default rule is motion-based') and VanillaSoundEventOracle computes attenuation with the 26.x formula mirrored in the oracle ('1.21.11's Sound exposes only the base attenuation distance; the volume scaling is the 26.x getAttenuationDistance(volume) formula (max(volume, 1) * base), mirrored by the Rust fixture'). Whether the Rust probes/fixtures match these changed outputs is unverified — no driver was run in this batch. Family-batch triage (drive the suffocation/sound drivers end-to-end), not a Batch 0 fix.

method: Fixpoint big-compile of all 391 Java oracles against the named 1.21.11 jars on three classpaths (server, client, both), one javac invocation per fixpoint round; driver mapping by parsing oracle basenames + oracle-name string literals across all 648 drivers. Measurement + triage only — no oracle was repaired and no driver was run in this batch, per the sweep brief (checks + triage only, do not touch versions/1.21.11/ code). The one exception is the probe check (H01): game_loop_probe.rs was checked statically against the 1.21.11 tree and the coordinator's cargo check is PENDING — see report.md. Systematic groups verified against the 1.21.11 jars with javap / jar listings (never assumed from the 26.3 base or the 1.21.10 form); the 1.21.10 jar was listed/javap'd to date the 1.21.11-era API arrivals.
name: Oracle measurement (Batch 0, no repairs)
out_of_scope_failures: No driver was run, so no parity defect was found by execution in this batch; the 9-harness check (1.21.7's table, re-measured) shows ALL 9 harnesses' oracles pass on at least one classpath for 1.21.11 at measurement time — chunk_generation (VanillaChunkGenerationOracle, all cps), command_exec (VanillaCommandExecOracle, all cps — Batch 9's command_parse run is NOT oracle-blocked), component_patch (VanillaComponentPatchOracle, all cps — and no runtime crash: the Optional.empty() form is in this tree, see O12), datafix (VanillaDataFixOracle, all cps), first_person (VanillaFirstPersonOracle, client + both), food (VanillaFoodOracle, all cps), item_model (VanillaItemModelOracle, client + both), options (VanillaOptionsOracle, client + both) and resource_pack (VanillaPackResourcesOracle, client + both). The 254 drivers with no oracle reference were mapped but not run (server-e2e/data/wrappers — outside the oracle-measurement scope). Prepared horizon-client data does not exist anywhere on the VM and must be built before any driver runs (see report.md).
source: docs/PARITY-SWEEP.md section 4 Batch 0 + section 3 methodology — measurement run 2026-11-25, checks + triage only, no port behaviour touched, no oracle repaired. Per-oracle table: docs/sweep/1.21.11/batch-0-oracles.json; full report: docs/sweep/1.21.11/batch-0-measurement.md.
systemic_note: Same root cause as the pilot's G1/G3/G5/G6, one API step back instead of two: the 1.21.11 tree carries 26.3 API forms (packages, constructors, abstract methods, holder classes) for things that do not exist in vanilla 1.21.11, and every such reference fails loudly at javac time in the oracles (unlike the port code, where the same pattern silently degrades). New vs 1.21.10: the 1.21.11-era APIs (GameRules, entity sub-packages, permissions, gizmos, world.attribute) now EXIST in the jar, and the template port adapted 19 oracle sources to 1.21.11 in-tree — so this run improves on 1.21.10 (23 new passes, 0 new fails) instead of degrading further. But the adaptation is uneven: the 17 re-ported 26.3-form files are still 26.3-form, and in 7 files the 1.21.10 port adapted further than the template did. The 1.21.7 sweep's repairs are not in this tree and must be re-derived for 1.21.11 (11-arg ServerLevel, not 12-arg; gamerules package, not world.level) — with the ComponentPatch Optional.empty() form already in-tree as the exception.
